Name: Alchemist's Yangpun Noodles Cart_
Author: AlchemistYeoni
Description:
Description
Bring a taste of Korean street food to Stardew Valley with Alchemist's Yangpun Noodles Cart!
Enjoy a selection of 13 noodle and rice noodle dishes, along with fish cake soup. The cart also offers ingredients and recipes for regular customers, free side dishes, and refills. Illuminated signage and cooking animations bring the cart to life.
Key Features
• 13 varieties of noodles and rice noodles
• Fish cake soup
• Ingredient and recipe sales for regular customers
• Free side dishes and refills
• Illuminated signage and cooking animations
• Korean-language content

Location & Business Hours
• Location: On the path just north of Jodi’s house in Pelican Town.
• Opening hours: 9:00 AM–9:00 PM.
• Closed every Sunday.

Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher and ScaleUp 2.7.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod.[/*]
[*]Place both folders — “Yangpun Noodles Cart” and “[CP] Yangpun Noodles Cart” — in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
• Content Patcher
• ScaleUp 2.7.0 or later (Arborsm.ScaleUpUnofficial)
Both included mod folders are required for the cart to work.
Credits & Shoutouts
Created by Alchemist.
Thank you to the creators and maintainers of SMAPI, Content Patcher, and ScaleUp for the tools that make this mod possible.
